data.one_liner: Dpad container focus navigation support for Android TV.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dpad focus navigation support for Android TV by letting you wrap widgets in a DpadContainer. It allows users to easily navigate widgets and get focused.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application for Android TV.
You need a simple way to add Dpad focus and navigation to existing widgets by wrapping them.
avoid_when: You are not targeting Android TV or Dpad inputs.
You require complex custom focus traversal policies not supported by simple container wrappers.
strengths: Easy to use by simply wrapping widgets.
Built with flutter_hooks for clean state handling.
weaknesses: Topics and advanced configuration details are not documented.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
